purpose: amplify fingertip contact into a camera-visible 3-5 mm displacement for fixed-scale relative force

geometry.marker_boss_face: camera-facing side of moving shoe; clear of the object-contact surface
geometry.compression_axis: normal to adhesive base toward rigid jaw
geometry.installation: bond one flexure base to each rigid inner fingertip face using thin high-strength double-sided adhesive

markers.rigid_reference: existing three yellow pad dots per jaw
markers.moving_marker: 6 mm matte black circular sticker centered on the camera-facing moving-shoe boss
markers.measurement: moving marker displacement in the per-jaw rigid yellow-dot coordinate frame

print.supports: none for first trial; reject parts with poor bridge fusion

checks: no collision through the full mechanical opening range
both contact shoes return to within 0.5 mm of unloaded position
maximum safe squeeze produces at least 20 pixels of moving-marker travel
hard stops engage before permanent flexure damage
50 compression cycles show no visible delamination or permanent set

policy.next_step: print pair STL, install, record unloaded/opening/squeeze calibration capture, then freeze 0-100 percent mapping
